canonical_project: Heartland Industrial Park / Potentia Sullivan County campus
aliases: Heartland Industrial Park / Potentia Sullivan County campus

location.site_description: Reported southwest of Sullivan along U.S. Route 41, near the Merom Generating Station; IDEM stormwater NOI public notices identify Township 7 North, Range 10 West, Sections 10-15. No civic street address was confirmed.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. Public-notice evidence shows Heartland Industrial Park LLC submitted Indiana construction-stormwater NOI notices for Project Nova tree clearing and Project Nova Phase 1 in Sullivan County, and Potentia announced on 2026-04-23 that construction had begun at Heartland Industrial Park. Local/regional reporting says Sullivan County Commissioners signed road-use and community-enhancement agreements in late March 2026. No county-hosted agenda/minutes packet, building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, IURC cause number, IEDC award, named anchor tenant, or full buildout record was located in this refresh.
evidence_grade: B - construction/site-work is supported by IDEM NOI public notices, local reporting on county agreements, and Potentia's first-party construction announcement; official county permit/minutes and energization evidence were not independently located.

status_history.note: Baseline extract carried no independent status, capacity, owner, or pinned location.

actions.government_body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management / Tribune-Star public notice
actions.summary: Heartland Industrial Park LLC submitted notice of intent to comply with Indiana's Construction Stormwater General Permit for Project Nova - Tree Clearing in Sullivan County, Township 7 North, Range 10 West, Sections 10-15; runoff was listed to Turtle Creek and Turtle Creek Reservoir.
actions.evidence_note: Public notice of state stormwater compliance intent; supports site-preparation activity but is not a building permit, occupancy record, or energization record.

actions.summary: Regional public-media reporting says Sullivan County Commissioners signed road-use and community-enhancement agreements with Heartland Industrial Park to support the proposed multi-phase industrial/data-center campus.
actions.evidence_note: Local-media report of county action; county-hosted official minutes or packet were not located on the accessible county site during this refresh.

actions.summary: Indiana Public Media reported the announcement followed county agreements; described the site as an approximately 1,000-acre industrial park along U.S. Route 41 near the former Merom power plant, serving light manufacturers and data centers, with about $65 billion projected private investment.
actions.evidence_note: Useful for location and scope context; its statement that a construction date had not been announced was superseded by Potentia's 2026-04-23 construction-start announcement.

actions.government_body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management / Tribune-Star public notice
actions.summary: Heartland Industrial Park LLC submitted notice of intent to comply with Indiana's Construction Stormwater General Permit for construction activity associated with Project Nova - Phase 1, described as a light-use industrial development in Sullivan County, Township 7 North, Range 10 West, Sections 10-15; runoff was listed to Turtle Lake and Turtle Creek Reservoir.
actions.evidence_note: Public notice of state stormwater compliance intent; stronger site-work evidence than announcement alone, but still not a building permit, occupancy record, or energization record.

actions.summary: Potentia announced that construction had begun on a large-scale technology infrastructure development at Heartland Industrial Park, with expected $65 billion total tenant/partner investment by 2030, 2,750 construction jobs, at least 500 permanent jobs, Phase 1 tenant commitments, no tax abatements, 100% self-funded power infrastructure, closed-loop water, and no conventional backup diesel generators.
actions.evidence_note: First-party construction and project-scope claim; not independent proof of building permit, energization, or live service.

actions.summary: Inside INdiana Business reported that construction was underway on Phase 1, the first building was expected by the end of 2026, a second building in early to mid-2027, and the first-building tenant was a data-center operator whose identity was not disclosed.
actions.evidence_note: Regional reporting with developer interview; use timeline and tenant details as reported projections, not completed milestones.

capacity_note: No public source reviewed disclosed a project IT/load capacity in MW. Potentia describes the broader platform as gigawatt-scale and reports $65 billion total tenant/partner investment by 2030, but those figures are not a data-center MW capacity.
owner: Potentia Inc. / Heartland Industrial Park LLC (developer/project entity; anchor tenant not publicly disclosed)

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; refreshed with Project Nova/Heartland Industrial Park evidence in Sullivan County

contradictions.details: Indiana Public Media reported on 2026-04-01 that a construction date had not been announced; Potentia later announced on 2026-04-23 that construction had begun, and Inside INdiana Business reported on 2026-05-04 that Phase 1 construction was underway.
contradictions.resolution: Treat the 2026-04-01 statement as superseded by later first-party and regional reporting; current status is site work-construction, not energized or live.

contradictions.details: Potentia's 2026-04-23 site post says first phase completion is scheduled for 2027, while Inside INdiana Business reported on 2026-05-04 that the first building was expected by the end of 2026 and a second building in early to mid-2027.
contradictions.resolution: Record both as developer-reported projections; do not treat either as completed construction, occupancy, or service evidence.
